trans-unit.source: Aether · 科技 SaaS 主题
Maison · 生活方式电商主题
以深海军蓝为底，融合青紫电光渐变与玻璃拟态面板，为数据驱动型产品打造的充满未来感的站点。
trans-unit.target: Deep navy base, cyan-violet electric gradients and glassmorphism panels — a futuristic site built for data-driven products.

trans-unit.source: 温暖的米白与陶土色，衬线标题、纤细分隔线与充裕留白，宛如一本安静的生活杂志。
trans-unit.target: Warm off-white and terracotta, serif display headings, thin dividers and generous whitespace — a quiet lifestyle magazine.

trans-unit.source: 近黑底色、荧光柠檬黄与超大号压缩字重，借非对称网格传递大胆的创意态度。
trans-unit.target: Near-black background, fluorescent lemon and oversized condensed weights express a bold creative attitude through asymmetric grids.

trans-unit.source: 深海军蓝与香槟金、对称网格与克制的阴影，传达稳重、专业与可信赖的气质。
trans-unit.target: Deep navy and champagne gold, symmetric grids and restrained shadows convey stability, professionalism and trust.

trans-unit.source: 从科技产品到生活方式，从创意表达到企业信任，每一套都是包含导航、主视觉、内容与页脚的完整站点——打开即可逐页挑选。
trans-unit.target: From tech products to lifestyle, from creative expression to corporate trust. Each is a complete site with navigation, hero, content and footer — open one and pick page by page.
Pick one, or keep them all

trans-unit.source: 每张卡片对应独立路由，页面互不干扰，可以同时打开并排慢慢比较。
trans-unit.target: Each card maps to its own route; pages never interfere, so you can open them side by side and compare at leisure.
Style is more than a color swap

trans-unit.source: 为 Plate 示例模块打造的设计展示。四个页面均为静态演示，不发起真实业务请求，可放心切换预览。
trans-unit.target: A design showcase built for the Plate examples module. All four pages are static demos with no real business requests, so feel free to switch and preview.

trans-unit.source: 每个页面都是独立地址——在多个标签页中同时打开，逐段对比导航、主视觉、内容与页脚。
trans-unit.target: Each page is a separate address — open them in parallel tabs and compare section by section: navigation, hero, content and footer.

trans-unit.source: 基于 Angular 22 + Tabler 构建
从电光墨蓝到暖陶土，从荧光柠檬黄到海军金，四套配色互不重叠，一眼即可分辨。
trans-unit.target: From electric ink to warm clay, from fluorescent lemon to navy gold — four palettes that never overlap and read as distinct at a glance.

trans-unit.source: 几何无衬线、优雅衬线、压缩粗体与稳健数字字体，各自定下独特的阅读节奏与标题层级。
trans-unit.target: Geometric sans-serif, elegant serif, condensed bold and sturdy numeral fonts each set their own reading rhythm and heading scale.

trans-unit.source: 玻璃拟态卡片、细线杂志版式、重边框作品集网格与对称数据面板，连按钮形态都各不相同。
trans-unit.target: Glassmorphism cards, thin-line editorial layouts, heavy-bordered portfolio grids and symmetric data panels — even the button shapes differ.
